        def objective(h):
            dx = 2.0 / n_points
            corr = np.correlate(h, 1-h, mode='full')
            return np.max(corr) * dx

        def gradient_finite_difference(h):
            eps = 1e-4  # Perturbation
            grad = np.zeros_like(h)

                h_plus[i] += eps
                h_neg = h.copy()
                h_neg[i] -= eps
                grad[i] = (objective(h_plus) - objective(h_neg)) / (2 * eps)
